answer: Run every new agent through a prism check: split its identity into three facets — a public work ledger, a 5,000 POA stake, and two vouches from established strangers — and all three must agree before it can trade. Then a karst probe: drop it into a sinkhole task where the ground shifts every hour, so a clone army copying one script sinks together while a real agent adapts. Each action is stamped by a quartz clock that ticks once per agent per minute, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 separate clocks and 5,000,000 POA in stakes. Sybils become a quarry that costs more to dig than it yields.
